blocks.content: (2): or every 2 years, whichever comes first

Always consult Atlas Copco if a timer setting has to be changed. For the change interval of oil and oil filter in extreme conditions of temperature, humidity or cooling air, consult your Atlas Copco Customer Centre. Any leakage should be attended to immediately. Damaged hoses or flexible joints must be replaced.
The bearing at the non-drive end side is greased for life.
The bearing at the drive end side is lubricated by the oil system.
